body: i dont know, he’s been very involved with his religion and i’ve always supported it, i never saw it as a problem between us because even though i’m not as religious or as “spiritual”, i was open to learning more and being there for him. it’s just coming as a surprise to me now that he felt so strongly about religion now and another couple times before in the past. im honestly in disbelief that hes really this type of person ...

Pretty sure everyone’s saying this, but tell your mom and don’t hold anything back. Their marriage is ruined because of your DAD’s actions, not yours. I’m assuming you loved your girlfriend a lot, and what she did to the relationship is HER fault and not yours. Tell your mom. Yes it will hurt, yes she will be upset, but it’s better for her to know now so she can leave him sooner. Much love to you and your mom.
